name: Little Thief
summary:
Little Thief is a thrilling VR game where you sneak into wealthy homes, stealing anything you can grab - over 400 unique items! But choose wisely: your backpack space is limited. Select carefully, steal boldly!

Use items and your environment to set mischievous traps for unsuspecting homeowners. But watch out - if you're caught, they'll call the police, and you'll be forced to make a daring escape!

From portraits and jewels to even the homeowner's gold teeth, steal valuable items and cash them in for advanced burglary tools. Unlock new possibilities to enter previously inaccessible areas and snatch even greater treasures!
